title: Each prompt is written to generate exactly ~15 seconds of smooth, cinematic…
content:
Each prompt is written to generate exactly ~15 seconds of smooth, cinematic footage. 
Copy-paste one at a time into using Seedance 2.0. Generate at 1080p, 24fps, realistic style. 
Stitch them in CapCut for a seamless 30-second short film.
